avis.titre: Deeply hydrating and leaves my skin soft, plump, and glowing!
avis.texte: I've been using the Medicube Salmon DNA PDRN Capsule Cream every evening for about a month, and it has become one of my favorite moisturizers. I was looking for a cream that would deeply hydrate my skin, strengthen my skin barrier, and leave my complexion looking healthy and radiant—and this definitely delivered. What worked well: The capsule formula melts into the skin as you apply it, leaving my face feeling incredibly soft and nourished without feeling greasy. After a few weeks of consistent use, I noticed my skin looked smoother, more hydrated, and noticeably plumper. I wake up every morning with skin that feels refreshed and has a healthy glow. It also layers beautifully over my serums and doesn't pill under sunscreen or makeup. What could be improved: I don't have any major complaints. If you have very oily skin, you may find it a little rich for daytime use, but it's perfect as a nighttime moisturizer. Who I'd recommend it to: I would recommend this cream to anyone with dry, dehydrated, combination, or mature skin looking for long-lasting hydration and a brighter, healthier-looking complexion. It's especially great if you're trying to improve your skin barrier or achieve a more radiant, "glass skin" look. Was the description accurate? Yes! The product looked exactly like the listing. The capsule texture was unique and fun to use, and it performed exactly as described. A little goes a long way, so the jar should last quite a while. Overall, I'm extremely happy with this

avis.titre: Medicube capsule cream - fun, hydrating, comfortable.
avis.texte: I really enjoy using this moisturizer. It's one of those products that actually makes skincare feel a little more fun. The dual texture with the gel and blue capsules lets you customize how lightweight or rich you want it to feel. I usually mix them together and apply as the final step in my routine, and it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and nicely hydrated without being greasy or heavy. It layers well with other products and doesn't cause any pilling for me. I've tried using just the capsule and just the gel separately but I do prefer a pretty even mix of both. The formula itself is built around solid hydrating and barrier supporting ingredients like glycerin, butylene glycol, niacinamide, panthenol, squalane, and ceramide NP, so it does a good job of keeping my skin comfortable and moisturized throughout the day. Most gel products are too light for my dry skin, but this one feels soothing and deeply hydrating. I also like that it doesn't have any real scent and that it feels gentle on my skin. The packaging is really cute, and the capsule concept makes it feel a bit more special compared to a standard cream. This is a fun, effective moisturizer that delivers reliable hydration while also being enjoyable to use. On days where I'm tired and don't want to perform self care, I can usually still talk myself into washing my face to play around with this cream. It's satisfy to mix and leaves my skin glowy.
